Klasse IntervalTree<A extends Activity>

java.lang.Object
com.flexganttfx.model.util.IntervalTree<A>
Typparameter:
A - the activity type
public class IntervalTree<A extends Activity> extends Object
An interval tree implementation to store activities based on their start and end time.
